data.completion_memo: Implemented deterministic ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1 classification and activation planning plus the exact journal-fenced selector adapter. Source checkouts require explicit enrollment; packaged, unknown, conflicting, mismatched, drifted, or incomplete guarantees only downgrade eligibility. Candidate switch and previous restore are anchored, idempotent, generation-bound, and ambiguity-safe.
data.description: Implement platform-neutral build-origin/enrollment classification, deterministic capability reports, fixed per-user unprivileged enrollment plans, selector observation/switch/restore/verify contracts, rollback-compatible data checks, and a hermetic profile adapter for fault testing. Unsupported classifications fail before quiescence with no force bypass. Native Windows, macOS, and Linux filesystem/selector ports are owned by M12.1.
data.title: M11.4 — Implement ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1 decisions and selector contracts
